title: A Negotiation-Aware Hybrid LLM Framework for Intent Interpretation and Service Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.40161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Increasingly, users express their needs as natural-language intents rather than structured requests. These intents may be incomplete, high-level, or internally conflicting. A conflicting intent either violates fundamental properties of the cloud paradigm or states mutually inconsistent requirements. Classical composition approaches are designed for structured, low-level, and complete requests. They cannot interpret such intents, discover suitable services from provider catalogs, or negotiate conflicting requirements with users. To address this gap, we propose a negotiation-aware framework for intent interpretation and service discovery. The framework first refines the natural-language intent and dynamically detects conflicts. It then structures the intent into a provider-independent TOSCA template. translated_title: 面向意图解释与服务发现的协商感知混合LLM框架
translated_abstract: 越来越多的用户以自然语言意图而非结构化请求来表达他们的需求。这些意图可能是不完整的、高层次的，或内部存在冲突。冲突意图要么违反云范式的基本属性，要么陈述了相互矛盾的需求。经典的组合方法是为结构化、低层次且完整请求设计的，它们无法解释此类意图，无法从提供商目录中发现合适的服务，也无法与用户就冲突需求进行协商。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了一个用于意图解释与服务发现的协商感知框架。该框架首先细化自然语言意图并动态检测冲突，然后将意图结构化为与提供商无关的TOSCA模板。对于每项规范，该框架通过基于云提供商服务的确定性匹配来检索候选服务方案。部分冲突的……
tldr: 本文提出一种协商感知的混合LLM框架，能够解释不完整或相互冲突的自然语言用户意图，动态检测冲突并与用户协商，进而通过基于云提供商的确定性匹配实现与提供商无关的服务发现。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a negotiation-aware hybrid LLM framework that interprets incomplete or conflicting natural-language user intents, dynamically detects and negotiates conflicts with users, and achieves provider-independent service discovery through deterministic matching grounded in cloud provider offerings.
